notes.notes: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730680/Table_Tactics/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512859/6691db90b0153e2e6f0e77167e57e1cc108f4dab.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]A turn-based strategy game where all units are tabletop figurines that you need to physically knock over. No health points, no stats, just physics at its best (and worst!)[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512859/a4d8e654b8566de87d4d7eae2adb9802473ca0c8.gif"][/img][/p][p]“Table Tactics” is a unique blend of strategy and physics, played with little miniature figurines. Imagine you are staring at your kitchen table where you laid out a little fantasy diorama and carefully placed miniatures to defend your castle. Alas, enemy units are coming from all directions! But instead of decreasing their health or worrying about armor, you must physically knock them over by shooting various projectiles (like arrows or marbles), using traps, or pushing them off the table. You’ll need to take the shape and weight of each figurine into consideration.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512859/aecc86eb261155ec1537557b04c9e1cc5fa09847.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Wishlist Now:[/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730680/Table_Tactics/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

Jakub the Creative Director here! Hard to believe we've been ruining weddings for two whole years now, wow, wow, wow! I wanted to share my excitement and gratitude to everyone playing, reviewing, sharing photos, drawing silly faces, and generally being a wonderful, rainy nuisance!

notes.title: Xbox Game Pass is losing a charming indie game later this month
notes.notes:
Xbox Game Pass always sees games come and go, and this month it sees titles like MLB The Show 21 and indie game Pathway leaving the service.

Sorry baseball fans, your chance to knock one out of the park in specifically the year 2021 is running out soon, as from April 16 MLB The Show 21 will no longer be available to play on Game Pass. Which includes both the Xbox One and the Xbox Series X|S versions of the game. This probably has something to do with the fact that MLB The Show 22 is out tomorrow, April 5, and will be available day one on Game Pass. So we're not that sorry, as you can still get all your wooden bat needs soon enough anyway.

What we are sorry about is that the beautiful Pathway is also being removed from Game Pass PC, also April 16. A couple of years ago, Pathway was available as a free download on the Epic Games Store, in line with an update at the time. It's a turn-based tactics game set in 1936 in which you try to prevent Nazis from hidden treasure in Northern African temples, which is in general a good thing to do.

Read more

notes.title: Looking for a new game like RoYP to get during the Steam Sales?
notes.notes:
If you already played [b]Rain on Your Parade[/b] and want some new in the similar style, here's a few recommendations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/732c44aa90ce03387d650c5748da1c7bde062d9f.gif[/img]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/785790/WHAT_THE_GOLF/]WHAT THE GOLF?[/url] [/b]- it's like RoYP, but golf instead of clouds! WHAT THE GOLF? combines zero rules with nonsensical physics and a ton of surprises – perfect for people who like their games, shall we say, unpredictable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/5d26baf99be3ca6eab1ffcbf7a198830dd386b72.gif[/img]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1205450/Turnip_Boy_Commits_Tax_Evasion/]Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion[/url][/b] - different gameplay, but same energy! Play as an adorable yet trouble-making turnip. Avoid paying taxes, solve plantastic puzzles, harvest crops and battle massive beasts all in a journey to tear down a corrupt vegetable government! (Features a little Cloudy Camo if you can find it)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/987a8e5f55765c9ad3d64927195b843a783155cc.gif[/img]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1018800/DEEEER_Simulator_Your_Average_Everyday_Deer_Game/]DEEEER Simulator[/url] [/b]- another unpredictable cartoon craziness. A “Slow-Life Town Destruction Game”. You can spend your days enjoying a nice, relaxed frolic here and there together with the other animals around town, or you can choose to relieve some stress and absolutely destroy the town and everything in it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/586d87ead0ed49068ba75240e71bd61eb5e95a46.gif[/img]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1424330/Wobbledogs/]Wobbledogs [/url][/b]- what if instead of your own Cloud, you had your own wobbly pet? A 3D pet simulation where you raise your own personal hive of mutating dogs, physically simulated all the way down to their guts! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/7ad51433a736aa74c45e225ab0ad3467512429ef.gif[/img]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/837470/Untitled_Goose_Game/]Untitled Goose Game[/url][/b] - you probably already heard about it but JUST in case! It's a lovely morning in the village and you are a horrible goose.

notes.title: First Week is Full of Updates! (Patch Notes)
notes.notes:
First of all, a[b] BIG THANK YOU to everyone who has submitted bugs to us!!![/b] You guys are awesome and helping us make Rain on Your Parade the best game it could be!

We definitely stayed busy fixing and tweaking as much as we could. You might have not noticed, but we've actually been update the Steam build [i]every night![/i] I think this is the first night when we're actually not pushing a new update (hopefully a good sign we fixed everything?) 

[h2]Here's the Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Re-designed the penultimate Seattle Defense level to speed it up and make it less tedious to re-play
[*] Fixed an exploit where you could unlock some achievements without actually doing the things you need to do (sorry!)
[*] Clarified some objective names and added hints to make some levels less confusing
[*] Improved face drawing smoothing when brush size is smol
[*] Added nicer background to Cardboard Gear Cloud (since so many of you enjoyed taking photos there!)
[*] A few quality-of-life and difficulty tweaks (like guards on Cardboard Gear Cloud having slightly shorter sight distance)
[*] Fixed a bunch of places where you could clip out of the world (particularly the Cloudbuster Canyon)
[*] Added "Join our Newsletter" button to main menu like the shameless self-promoting clouds we are
[*] Replaced some older decors with brand new, flashier ones!
[*] Fixed a bug in Weatherman Goes to Work that could cause cars not to appear
[*] Fixed missing collisions on some objects
[*] Bunch of other minor fixes we forgot!
[/list]

[i](if you're playing on consoles, don't worry - you got all the critical updates already, and anything left is coming soon as well!)[/i]

[h2]What's Next? YOU Tell us![/h2]

We're exploring our options, but we'd really LOVE to hear from you! We got a little 2-minute survey going: 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfdtT2vSy87exV4nXeriGI3bD7bv1PVaThyH5td2ldDI_S0Qw/viewform

We'd appreciate your feedback!

[h2]Help us Spread the Word[/h2]

If you enjoyed the game, you'd be doing us a big help if you'd mention it to your favorite streamers and Youtubers :) We've been sending tons of emails (SO MANY EMAILS) but at the end of the day, nothing works better than some good old word-of-mouth! And who wouldn't believe such amazing folks as yourselves ;D 


Anyway, that's it for the current update! More to come, I am sure, as well as new goodies and content like merch or DLC :O 

Cheers,
Jakub
Lead Dev 
On Behalf of Unbound Creations Team

notes.title: How to make a Cloudy Pumpkin for Halloween
notes.notes:
Here at Unbound Creations, we believe in the Cult of the Cloud, so naturally we spent our weekend carving an offering - The Pumpkin Cloud! And you, too, can carve one - for a mere $10 or less! Here's our recipe (WITHOUT 5 pages of personal life stories, what a treat).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/b0832d938fb0e89ddbdabfb2c6f211c341b4eee2.jpg[/img]

[h2][u][b]What you'll need[/b][/u][/h2]
[list]
[*] Pumpkin
[*] X-Acto Knife or Regular Knife
[*] Spoon
[*] One Marker Boi
[*] Candle
[*] Some household cleaner + rag/sponge
[*] OPTIONAL: a really cool significant other to do all the carving for you while you show them your favorite K-Pop tracks
[/list]

[h2][u][b]The Recipe[/b][/u][/h2]

[h3]1. Go into a field and find yourself a nice Pumpkin[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/d2141a5bf807ab2857fa566fabd453335ee1ef70.jpg[/img]

[h3]2. Use KNIFE to cut the Pumpkin's top off, and pull it out![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/cac23181ff8536704786c5624660da5fb8044913.gif[/img]

[h3]3. Use SPOON to scrape all the inside gooey bits. [/h3]
(PRO TIP: You can separate the seeds and dry + roast them in the oven for some yummy snack! But don't eat too much at once...)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/d0e1aaa63f4a24f2e2d1565af9805755bfeffdbf.jpg[/img]

[h3]4. Use MARKER to draw your design. Don't worry, you can cheat by printing it out and tracing it! Nobody will know, not even Mom![/h3]
(Here's a Link to the [url=https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/1316954034800979969/WTLc50Zb_400x400.jpg]Official Cloudy Image[/url]©℗®™ for reference)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/f9321ed29e54314b6e0fd1ac5bba1d9ee83c0e94.jpg[/img]

[h3]5. Now comes the tricky bit. Use KNIFE to scrape out the insides of all the shapes, leaving the outlines sticking out. You want to cut fairly deep to make the Pumpkin thin enough to see light thru, but not completely see-through. [/h3]
PRO TIP: We didn't have an X-Acto Knife, but my regular Knife had a slightly bent tip due to [REDACTED]. The bent tip actually made it easier to peel off and scrape pieces. 

When you are done you should have something like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/606930c0bc509bb6a53232df501363f6908cc31b.jpg[/img]

[h3]6. Use a wipe or cleaning detergent to rub off the remaining marker [/h3]

[h3]7. OPTIONAL: You can also use KNIFE to cut out the back, which will make it easier to insert candle.[/h3]

[h3]8: Insert lit CANDLE and turn off the lights....[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/b0832d938fb0e89ddbdabfb2c6f211c341b4eee2.jpg[/img]

[h3]SPOOPY!!![/h3]

Now go find a nice home for Cloudy Pumpkin, perhaps your porch, perhaps your bathtub, we're not here to tell you how to live your life, go wild and rain your heart's out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36590961/b0d4a208b763a3c6c071fcd78a12dafad7810479.jpg[/img]

[i]p.s. Many of you have asked - Jakub, why do you capitalize Pumpkin? My answer: yes[/i]

[b]Do you feel frustrated with the state of the world 😢?

Do you have pent up stress you need to take out 🤬?

Or maybe you enjoy making tiny virtual hoomans scream in terror 😈?[/b]

Check out the beta demo for "Rain on Your Parade" right here, right now! We're working hard on a lot of improvements and listening to feedback We want to give everyone a little taste of what the full game is all about and hear from YOU! :) 

Please [b]share your thoughts in the forums[/b] and, if it tickles your pickles, [b]add it to your wishlist! [/b]
